title: AccountMenu
wrapsNative: A Button with MonarchAvatar as the trigger and, open, a card of rows: the signed-in name and address, Profile and Settings, the workspace and theme choices under their own titles with a dot on the current one, and Sign out. (MonarchElevation, MonarchDivider, MonarchIcon)
summary: A recipe, not a component: the signed-in person's menu, an avatar button that opens a system menu with who is signed in, Profile and Settings, a workspace switcher, the colour scheme and Sign out.
whenToUse: In the toolbar or header of an app with accounts, as the one place for the person's own settings and signing out.
whenNotToUse: For a full account screen with many settings, push a Form from a toolbar button instead. For switching workspaces as the main navigation, use a dedicated switcher in the sidebar.
api: Menu { Section("Signed in as …") { Button("Profile", systemImage:) {}; Button("Settings", systemImage:) {} }; Picker("Switch workspace", selection:) { … }.pickerStyle(.menu); Picker("Theme", selection: $scheme) { … }.pickerStyle(.menu); Divider(); Button("Sign out", systemImage:, role: .destructive) {} } label: { MonarchAvatar(image:name:size:status:isDecorative:) }

states.description: The avatar, with a presence dot when given, as the menu's button.

states.name: open
states.description: The system menu: the signed-in address as the section title, Profile and Settings, the workspace and theme pickers as submenus that show the current choice, and Sign out in the destructive colour.

states.name: with name
states.description: The label can be the avatar and the name in an HStack, for wide toolbars.

appearance: The avatar keeps its Monarch colours; the menu is the system menu in every theme, with the destructive role drawing Sign out in the system red.
platformNotes: The web ships AccountMenu as one component with user, workspaces, theme and callback props, and renderLink for router links. On iOS it is a recipe: Menu already gives the trigger, focus, keyboard and VoiceOver behaviour, and on a phone the system menu is the expected surface, so no Monarch type is added. The theme picker binds the same MonarchSchemePreference that MonarchThemeToggle uses; apply it with .monarchTheme(scheme:) and keep it with @AppStorage through MonarchThemeToggle.storageValue(for:). The web's workspaceSlot and items props are the app's own Menu items. The web's "sheet on phones" option is not needed: the system menu fits phone screens; push a Form if the account options grow.
accessibility: The menu's button is named "Account menu for <name>" with accessibilityLabel; the avatar inside is decorative.
The pickers are read as menus with their current value; each choice is read with a selected state.
Sign out uses the destructive role, which VoiceOver announces.
The avatar label keeps a 44-point touch target with monarchMinimumHitTarget().
edgeCases: With one workspace, leave the workspace picker out.
Long names and addresses in the section title are truncated by the system menu.
Signing out usually needs a confirmation only when there is unsaved work; use confirmationDialog then.
